Prarambh FAQs: "the selected innovator companies will be provided mentorship, counselling and guidance by the Prarambh team. Stand-out deals on PE page: "Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised the Buyer Consortium on the acquisition of the IPL franchise Rajasthan Royals, for USD 1.6 Billion" and "advises Hygenco Green Energies Private Limited on its USD 105 million capital raise from IFC, Siemens and Fullerton".

DPDP Rules article (Nov 2025): "India's digital privacy regime entered a new phase with the notification of the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Rules, 2025.
